faces.transcription: Move any City cards under the Disrupt Trial objective to the Player discard pile. Then draw the Pause card in the Legacy deck and read it.
faces.flavor: All three cities were saved through substantial effort. By all indications, the MEDUSA trials are at an end. The Soviets will have everything they need to produce a fully lethal strain; it is only a matter of time before they use it.
